units.source_text: 却说紫姬的乳母少纳言进二条院后，心中常想：

en.t: Now, after Lady Murasaki's nurse, Shonagon, entered the Nijo residence, she often thought to herself:
This is truly like stumbling straight into a jar of honey!

units.source_text: 多管是已故的尼姑老太太关念小姐终身大事，

en.t: Most likely, the late old nun was concerned for the young lady's lifelong future,

units.source_text: 常在修行中替她祈祷，因此诸佛保佑，得此福报吧。”

en.t: and often prayed for her during her religious practice, so the Buddhas protected her and granted her this blessed fortune.

units.source_text: 正妻葵姬身份高贵，况且公子另有许多情妇，

en.t: Lady Aoi, the principal wife, is of noble rank, and besides, the young lord has many other lovers,

units.source_text: 将来紫姬成人，婚嫁之后，难免遭逢不幸吧。

en.t: so when Lady Murasaki grows up and marries, she may inevitably meet with unhappiness.

units.source_text: 然而公子对她如此宠爱，将来必可确保无忧。

en.t: Yet since the young lord cherishes her so deeply, he will surely be able to keep her free from worry in the future.
